newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans slip on Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans slip on Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash May soybeans slipped in low volume trade at Buenos Aires Cereas Exchange on weaker Chicago prices, traders said.

Cash new crop maize also weakened, sapped by a lower CBOT. Volume was moderate to good. Cash January wheat firmed in tight trade, with prices supported by the FOB market, and despite good rais in southeast Buenos Aires over the weekend. Cash sunflower seed was steady in slow trade, with weak oil and soybean price sapping the market.
